About the show

Darren Connell is back with a brand-new special that leans even further into the chaos. I Know What You’re Thinking is a fearless, fast-moving hour where nothing is off-limits and no thought goes unexamined. Fresh from the success of Cancelled, Darren doubles down on what sets him apart...
